conversation.user: I'm in Seattle. Will the city approve my hempcrete walls under Appendix BL?
conversation.assistant:
Yes, you can certainly submit plans using the 2024 International Residential Code Appendix BL standard for hemp-lime construction in Seattle, though local building departments always have final jurisdiction. Hempcrete is 100% legal, contains 0% THC, is fire-resistant, and has nothing to do with recreational marijuana. Just keep in mind that our calculator numbers are planning estimates, not stamped engineering or permit-ready calculations.
